jobs.occupation: Scientist (m/f/d) (100%) (Data Scientist)
jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

Within the EU-funded research project "MEDSoil+: Excellence in Mediterranean Soil Regeneration", the Mediterranean Institute for Agriculture, Environment and Development (MED) of the University of Évora (UE, Portugal) will be positioned as the first fully accredited soil lab infrastructure in Portugal capable of generating high-quality, standardised and interoperable soil monitoring data, by training, co-designing innovation, demonstrating and disseminating breakthrough knowledge through Living Labs (LL). The ATB will accompany and consult this process and will be particularly responsible for establishing proximal & remote sensing and IoT solutions for connected soil health mapping and monitoring. For this task, we are looking for the following person from 1 January 2027

Scientist (m/f/d) (100%)

Yourtasks

- Utilise proximal and remote sensing technologies to generate high-spatial-resolution soil property maps
- Deploy IoT and remote sensing technologies to establish a soil health monitoring system delivering high-temporal-resolution data streams
- Establish a federated soil data platform combining decentralised data access and governance with a secure central repository, integrating scientific data, sensor outputs and local knowledge to support soil intelligence, research and policymaking
- Develop robust AI and machine-learning algorithms for soil data fusion, predictive analytics, uncertainty quantification and scenario modelling
- Co-design, adapt and integrate user-oriented decision support systems (DSS) that translate soil intelligence, predictive uncertainty and AI-driven analytics into actionable and reliable recommendations for farmers, land managers and landowners

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree (Master/Diploma) and ideally a PhD with focus in soil science and data science
- Very good knowledge and experience in sensor-based soil mapping and DSS
- Very good knowledge and experience in optical spectroscopy, sensor calibration and data science
- Very good programming skills (R, Python)
- Knowledge in agriculture, soil science, proximal and remote sensing and geographic information systems
- Very good written and spoken English and good knowledge of German
- Independent work, high personal commitment, reliability, flexibility, ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate are required
- Experience in writing articles for scientific journals and publication record in the above research fields
- Willingness to present project results at international conferences
- Willingness to travel into other EU countries
- Confident use of MS Office programs
- EU driving license class B

We offer

- An attractive, research-intensive and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is limited to six years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Sebastian Vogel (E-Mail: svogel@atb-potsdam.de) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we piqued your interest? Then apply by 30 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-AM-3) at https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . Applications received after the application deadline cannot be considered. 

Interviews will take place on 20 October 2026.

As a certified family-friendly institute, the ATB is committed to equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnic or social background, age, religion, disability, or sexual identity. Applications from people with severe disabilities are particularly encouraged and will be given preference in the event of equal qualifications.

By submitting your application, you agree that your documents may be stored for up to six months even in the case of an unsuccessful application. Further information on data protection can be found here:
https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/data-protection-declaration-for-the-application-process (https://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/data-protection-declaration-for-the-application-process) .

jobs.occupation: Hardware Engineering Program Manager (m/f/d) #200679831 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Apple Technology Engineering B.V. & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Summary

Apple's Hardware Program Management organization is looking for a Program Manager to lead PMIC silicon validation hardware programs end-to-end—from initial board design through factory builds, field deployment, and ongoing support for our validation engineers. This is an individual contributor role on a high-caliber Senior Program Management team whose mission is to deliver power management silicon on schedule. You will be embedded in the heartbeat of Apple's chip development process, driving the validation hardware programs that enable our advanced PMICs to go from first bring-up to production release. In this role, you will coordinate all aspects of hardware development, including requirements definition, design, implementation, and resolving complex technical issues. To be successful, you will need a strong technical background in board design, HW/SW integration, and ideally, project management experience in system board design or FPGA development. A proven track record in a dynamic engineering environment, along with exceptional multitasking and real-time crisis management skills, are essential for this position.

Description

• Coordinate development hardware requirements from multi-functional teams • Track project schedule for all development phases to ensure HW development schedules are met • Run development hardware builds, craft and manage build matrix for hardware configurations, • manage the factory teams to meet build objectives. Drive allocation requests and distribution of hardware with those multi-functional teams • Support development hardware needs for product and IC design teams • Engage with operations team to drive material delivery for builds • Drive resolution of technical issues between multi-functional teams • Convert large amounts of data into a clear story to communicate to organizations at all levels • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and facilitate conflict resolution • Focused issue reporting and communication of program risks and status • Technical understanding of system design and silicon validation planning

Responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

- BS in electrical engineer or related engineering degree
- 3 year’s experience in hardware design and/or project management
- Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years experience in project or program management, preferably within a hardware, semiconductor, silicon validation, or systems engineering environment.
- Foundational understanding of hardware development and the board design lifecycle, from concept and specification through schematic review, fabrication, bring-up, and production.
- Ability to manage complex, multi-functional programs with aggressive schedules and high-stakes technical dependencies.
- Strong communication and leadership skills, able to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and leadership stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts; comfortable digging into technical details to understand blockers and drive resolution.
- Experience supporting silicon bring-up and post-silicon validation environments is highly desirable.

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability

- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed

- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised

- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

At TYTAN, every mission starts with a first impression, and that's where you come in. As our Office Manager and Team Assistant you are the face and the heartbeat of our Berlin representation. You'll be the first point of contact for guests and partners. You will shape the daily rhythm of the office, create a welcoming environment for our international team, and ensure that everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, including day-to-day support for the team and leadership.
As a young, fast-growing scale-up, we need someone who's comfortable wearing many hats and moving fluidly between office management, team support, and personal assistance to our team lead, depending on what the day brings.

Your roadmap to make an impact:

- Be the ambassador of TYTAN: warmly welcome visitors, partners, and new hires, ensuring they feel the unique spirit of our company from the moment they arrive.
- Keep operations flowing: oversee office organization, supplies, vendor coordination, and facility management to ensure a smooth daily workflow.
- Support leadership and teams: assist with scheduling, travel arrangements, and meeting coordination.
- Provide personal assistance to the team lead and keep the team running: manage calendars, coordinate travel, prepare meetings, and handle recurring personal and organizational matters with discretion.
- Create a vibrant workplace culture: organize events, foster a positive office atmosphere, and help maintain a space where collaboration thrives.
- Be the connector: act as the go-to person for day-to-day questions, guiding colleagues and visitors through processes with clarity and care.

Job requirements

- You bring experience in office management, administration, or a PA role.
- You are a people person: approachable, professional, and always ready to support colleagues and guests with a smile.
- You have excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with an eye for detail, and you enjoy taking ownership of organizational tasks.
- You are fluent in German and English, both spoken and written.
- You thrive in dynamic, young teams and enjoy wearing multiple hats.
- Experience with office tools (MS Office, HR/admin systems).

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
